description.value: Built in 2010, the Vedder River Inn is an award-winning, Canadian-owned motel nestled in the Fraser Valley near Vedder Crossing, roughly 100 km east of Vancouver. It offers a wide range of rooms and suites—from standard double rooms to full-kitchen executive suites sleeping up to seven—along with a complimentary continental breakfast each morning. The property sits steps from the Vedder River and Trans-Canada Trail, with fine dining, pubs, and franchise eateries immediately nearby.
